title: Discovery of specific antioxidant peptide from Chinese Dahe black pig and hybrid pig dry-cured hams based on peptidomics strategy.
authors: Wei, Guangqiang; Li, Xiang; Wang, Daodian; Zhao, Bo; Shi, Yanan; Huang, Aixiang
one_liner_zh: 该文基于肽组学发现火腿抗氧化肽并用分子对接研究其与Keap1/自由基作用，虽含分子对接但对象为肽-蛋白/自由基，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: The quality of hams obtained from different pig breeds can vary depending on endogenous antioxidant peptides in the hams. The aims of this study were (i) to investigate the specific peptides in Chinese Dahe black pig ham (DWH) and hybrid pig ham (Yorkshire x Landrace x Dahe black ham, YLDWH) and their antioxidant activity, and (ii) to elucidate the relationship between ham quality and antioxidant peptides. iTRAQ quantitative peptidomic method was used to discover specific peptides of DWH and YLDWH. In addition, in vitro assays were performed to evaluate their antioxidant activity. A total of 73 specific peptides were identified from DWH and YLDWH by LC-MS/MS. Forty-four specific peptides in DWH were primarily hydrolysed from myosin and myoglobin by endopeptidases, while 29 specific peptides in YLDWH were primarily hydrolysed from myosin and troponin-T. Six specific peptides that were statistically significantly different based on their fold changes and P-values were selected for the identification of DWH and YLDWH. DWH-derived specific peptide AGAPDERGPGPAAR (AR14), which had high stability and was non-toxic, had the highest DPPH* and ABTS*+ scavenging activity (IC(50) = 1.657 mg/mL and 0.173 mg/mL, respectively) and cellular antioxidant capacity. Molecular docking showed that AR14 interacted with Val369, and Val420 of Keap1 via hydrogen bonds. Furthermore, AR14 bound to DPPH and ABTS through hydrogen bonding and hydrophobic interactions. Together, our results demonstrate that the DWH-derived antioxidant peptide AR14 exhibits the free radical scavenging and cellular antioxidant activity and can be used to preserve ham quality and promote human health.
abstract_zh: 不同猪种火腿的品质可能因其内源性抗氧化肽的不同而有所差异。本研究旨在（i）探究中国大河黑猪火腿（DWH）和杂交猪火腿（约克夏×长白×大河黑猪火腿，YLDWH）中的特异性肽及其抗氧化活性，以及（ii）阐明火腿品质与抗氧化肽之间的关系。采用iTRAQ定量肽组学方法发现DWH和YLDWH的特异性肽。此外，通过体外实验评估其抗氧化活性。通过LC-MS/MS从DWH和YLDWH中共鉴定出73种特异性肽。DWH中的44种特异性肽主要由肌球蛋白和肌红蛋白经内肽酶水解产生，而YLDWH中的29种特异性肽主要由肌球蛋白和肌钙蛋白-T水解产生。根据倍数变化和P值，选取了6种统计学显著差异的特异性肽用于DWH和YLDWH的鉴定。源自DWH的特异性肽AGAPDERGPGPAAR（AR14）具有高稳定性和无毒性，表现出最高的DPPH*和ABTS*+清除活性（IC(50)分别为1.657 mg/mL和0.173 mg/mL）以及细胞抗氧化能力。分子对接显示，AR14通过氢键与Keap1的Val369和Val420相互作用。此外，AR14通过氢键和疏水相互作用与DPPH和ABTS结合。综上，我们的结果表明，源自DWH的抗氧化肽AR14具有自由基清除和细胞抗氧化活性，可用于保持火腿品质并促进人类健康。
